abstract: BACKGROUND: Giant mediastinal tumors in the pediatric population can pose unique challenges for resection such as cardiovascular collapse on induction of anesthesia and injury to surrounding structures that may be compressed, displaced, or invaded by the mass. Principles that must be borne in mind during removal of giant mediastinal masses include: appropriate cross-sectional imaging to define extent of mass; airway control during induction of anesthesia; a multidisciplinary collaborative approach including cardiothoracic surgery; preparation for urgent sternotomy; plan for peripheral cannulation to institute cardiopulmonary bypass if needed; preservation of neurovasculature structures during dissection; complete resection whenever possible. While complete resection is desirable and results in an excellent prognosis, it may not be achievable especially if the tumor encases coronary arteries, and it is acceptable to leave small amounts of tumor behind. CASE DESCRIPTION: Here we present a case describing surgical management of a giant mediastinal teratoma in a two-month-old female. The patient was found to have a large mediastinal mass during workup for cough and noisy breathing. She underwent preoperative echocardiogram demonstrating normal cardiac function followed by uncomplicated, open resection of the mass. CONCLUSIONS: Giant mediastinal tumors give rise to unique challenges for resection in small infants. The principles of airway control, preparation for urgent sternotomy, preparation for peripheral cardiopulmonary bypass cannulation, and preservation of neurovasculature during dissection must be borne in mind.
abstract_ja: 背景:小児の巨大縦隔腫瘍は、導入麻酔時の心血管虚脱や、圧迫・変位・浸潤された周囲構造への損傷など、切除に際して独特の課題をもたらす。巨大縦隔腫瘤の摘出時に留意すべき原則は以下のとおりである:腫瘤の範囲を determine するための適切な断面画像検査、導入麻酔時の気道管理、心臓血管外科を含む多職種による協働的アプローチ、緊急胸骨切開への準備、必要時に心肺バイパスを確立するための末梢カニュレーション計画、剥離時の神経血管構造の温存、可能な限りの完全切除。完全切除は望ましく優れた予後をもたらすが、腫瘍が冠動脈を取り囲む場合などでは達成できないこともあり、小量の腫瘍を残すことは許容される。症例記述:ここでは生後2か月の女児における巨大縦隔奇形腫の外科的管理を報告する。咳嗽と喘鳴の精査中に大きな縦隔腫瘤が発見された。術前心エコー検査で心機能は正常であり、その後、合併症なく開胸下に腫瘤を切除した。結論:小乳児の巨大縦隔腫瘍は切除において独特の課題を生じる。気道管理、緊急胸骨切開への準備、末梢心肺バイパスカニュレーションへの準備、剥離時の神経血管温存の原則を念頭に置く必要がある。
